picks.editorial_note: A £39 million UKRI investment creating 20 Turing AI Fellows is a substantial national-scale funding commitment aimed at building long-term UK AI research capacity across diverse domains.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review by MIT CSAIL and 17 other institutions cataloguing 95 concrete scenarios for AI-driven catastrophic risk is a significant contribution to AI safety scholarship with broad policy relevance.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's multi-laboratory FemtoMind project applying agentic AI to lattice QCD calculations represents a notable advance in using AI to accelerate fundamental physics research under the national Genesis Mission initiative.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: The acquisition of Imperial College London spinout Cogitat by Swiss neurotech firm Indivi demonstrates real commercial validation of an academic AI foundation model for decoding brain activity.
picks.title: Imperial spinout Cogitat acquired by Swiss startup Indivi for its brain foundation model

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Center for Marine Intelligence and its AI4Coral partnership with KAUST pairs two major research institutions to apply AI and robotics to coral reef conservation at scale.
picks.title: HKUST Establishes Center for Marine Intelligence and Partners with KAUST to Launch Inaugural AI4Coral Research Project
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led analysis finding a third of the global AI supply chain invisible to government oversight highlights a major gap with direct implications for AI governance and national security policy.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: Sandia National Laboratories' machine-learning approach to predicting metal alloy performance could produce a universal design guide with concrete industrial and defense engineering applications.
picks.title: Before the forge

picks.editorial_note: MIT research toward making deep learning models explain their own reasoning in human-understandable language addresses one of AI's most consequential open problems: interpretability.
picks.title: Learning the language of machine learning

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's use of Indiana's new FAA-designated Midwest UAS Test Site to advance beyond-visual-line-of-sight drone flight ties academic research directly to regulatory progress on autonomous aviation.
picks.title: Purdue drone research advances frontiers of autonomous aviation

picks.editorial_note: A master research agreement between the University of Kansas and SOFTwarfare on trustworthy, AI-driven secure computing is a concrete academia-industry partnership with cybersecurity applications.
